curation.lead:
Compagnie Du Saleve SA is a Luxembourg-incorporated holding company (Registre de Commerce et des Sociétés number B223232) registered on 23 March 2018 with EUR 6,854,000 of share capital and Legal Entity Identifier 254900TWD935XLM3HD91 [Finding #11211][Finding #11188]. Since 8 March 2023 the entire share capital has been held by Five Arrows AutoBench Holding Sarl (Lux RCS B209234), a Rothschild & Co Five Arrows private-equity vehicle that was itself placed into liquidation on 21 November 2024 with Five Arrows Managers SA appointed as liquidator [Finding #11211][Finding #11213].

The company is administered from 12 rue Guillaume Schneider, L-2522 Luxembourg — the domicile of fiduciary services provider NeoTrust Fiduciary, an address shared with SPQR Capital Holding SA and, per the ICIJ Offshore Leaks database, eleven Panama Papers entities [Finding #11211][Finding #11215]. Current directors are Pierre Moulière (appointed September 2019) and Mathieu Villaume (in post since the 23 March 2018 incorporation); previous board members included Othman Baraka and Lucie Delamontagne, both rotated off on 25 January 2023 [Finding #11211].

The 23 March 2018 incorporation date matters because it post-dates the 28 October 2015 Luxembourg courthouse hearing on Wind Hellas / TIM Hellas creditor litigation by roughly two and a half years; the entity associated with that 2015 proceeding is therefore not this Saleve B223232 but a different vehicle, most likely the now-closed French SARL registered under SIREN 803012046 in Monnetier-Mornex, Haute-Savoie [Finding #11188]. Cross-reference of the Luxembourg registry filings suggests Compagnie Du Saleve SA is the first documented intersection between the Rothschild & Co Five Arrows private-equity arm and the Mathieu Villaume contract-directorship portfolio that also services the SPQR Capital / Asherco LLP Benedetti–des Pallières circle [Finding #11166].
curation.system_role: Compagnie Du Saleve SA illustrates how the Luxembourg holding-company stack lets a single fiduciary address and a single professional director bridge the Rothschild & Co Five Arrows private-equity arm with the litigation-distressed SPQR / Asherco creditor circle, without either party sharing counsel, auditors, or a board seat directly.

sections.title: Corporate Structure and Registration
sections.content:
The company is a public limited company (société anonyme) registered with the Luxembourg Registre de Commerce et des Sociétés under matricule B223232, incorporated on 23 March 2018 [Finding #11211][Finding #11188]. Issued share capital is EUR 6,854,000 and the company carries Legal Entity Identifier 254900TWD935XLM3HD91 [Finding #11211]. Status as of the most recent registry refresh is active [Finding #11188].

The registered office at 12 rue Guillaume Schneider, L-2522 Luxembourg is the business address of NeoTrust Fiduciary, a corporate-services provider whose domicile co-hosts SPQR Capital Holding SA and, per the ICIJ Offshore Leaks database, eleven entities named in the Panama Papers leak [Finding #11211][Finding #11215]. The fiduciary co-location is structural rather than incidental, providing the mechanism by which jurisdictionally distinct vehicles share administration without sharing ownership.

The 23 March 2018 incorporation date rules out the Luxembourg entity B223232 as the vehicle present at the 28 October 2015 Wind Hellas / TIM Hellas creditor hearing, since the company did not yet exist on that date [Finding #11188]. The 2015 hearing entity is more plausibly a separate French SARL registered under SIREN 803012046 in Monnetier-Mornex, Haute-Savoie (a Geneva-border commune that shares the Salève toponym), since closed [Finding #11188].

sections.title: Beneficial Ownership and the Five Arrows Chain
sections.content:
Since 8 March 2023 the entire issued capital of Compagnie Du Saleve SA has been held by Five Arrows AutoBench Holding Sarl (Lux RCS B209234), a Rothschild & Co Five Arrows private-equity vehicle [Finding #11211][Finding #11213]. AutoBench Holding traces back to a 27 July 2018 record under its earlier name Five Arrows White C Holding Sarl, with the AutoBench rename effected on 2 December 2020 — confirming continuity of the same registry matricule across the renaming [Finding #11211][Finding #11213]. The previous shareholder of record between 2020 and 2021 was Luxfactory Group [Finding #11211].

Five Arrows AutoBench Holding Sarl was itself dissolved and placed into liquidation on 21 November 2024, with Five Arrows Managers SA (Lux RCS B143757) appointed as liquidator [Finding #11213]. The appointment of an in-house Five Arrows entity as liquidator points to AutoBench being an internal Rothschild & Co Five Arrows vehicle rather than a co-invest or partnered structure. Its capital of EUR 41.1 million flowed through shareholders FIN PO SA SICAR and Delphen Sarl, with managers Xavier Monnereau and Elisa Costanzo [Finding #11213].

The post-liquidation status of Saleve’s shareholding remains the central open question. In Luxembourg practice the shares of a liquidated parent typically transfer to a successor vehicle or revert to the ultimate beneficial owner of the Five Arrows fund, but no successor record has yet been confirmed for B223232 [Finding #11213].

sections.title: Directors and Officers
sections.content:
The current board comprises Pierre Moulière (appointed in September 2019) and Mathieu Villaume (in post since the 23 March 2018 incorporation) [Finding #11211]. A 25 January 2023 reshuffle terminated the directorships of Othman Baraka and Lucie Delamontagne, with Pierre-Yves Moulière documented at the same time as the lineage of Pierre Moulière's mandate [Finding #11211].

Villaume is the figure who recurs across these vehicles. Registry records characterise him as a Luxembourg professional director rather than a domiciliation agent, with at least 21 active mandates spanning Saleve, the now-terminated SPQR Capital Holding SA, the three parallel Knightsbridge Holding I/II/III SPVs (B279238, B280404, B281581), Anfield Capital, BlockTrust, Brandbull International, Cement Fund / GP, Chross, Cinchona, Codusa, ESI Group, HBB, JD Invest and Mosaic Real Estate, among others [Finding #11223]. Review of the filings indicates his directorship at Saleve is the first documented intersection between this mandate roster and the Rothschild & Co Five Arrows orbit [Finding #11166].

Villaume’s mandate-portability across five fiduciary employers — REYL & Cie, Alter Domus, IQ-EQ, Fundcraft and Vault Administration / Azur & Partners — is the operational mechanism that lets a single natural-person director stay attached to vehicles such as Saleve through successive employer changes [Finding #11129]. His co-directorships with Alessandro Benedetti and Bertrand G. des Pallières at SPQR Capital Holding SA from 1 March 2016 are documented in registry filings, and those mandates ended by 7 February 2018 — before Saleve’s 23 March 2018 incorporation — so the two assignments do not temporally overlap [Finding #11215]. Examination of the registry appointment dates shows that all three SPQR directors were installed simultaneously on 1 March 2016, a coordinated board-installation pattern coincident with the Wind Hellas creditor litigation phase [Finding #11226].

sections.title: Misidentification Correction
sections.content:
The Luxembourg company should not be confused with the entity present at the 28 October 2015 Luxembourg courthouse hearing on Wind Hellas / TIM Hellas creditor litigation. Saleve B223232 was not incorporated until 23 March 2018, two and a half years after that hearing [Finding #11188].

The 2015 hearing entity is more plausibly a separate (now-closed) French SARL registered under SIREN 803012046 in Monnetier-Mornex, Haute-Savoie — a French commune on the Geneva border that shares the Salève toponym with the Luxembourg company [Finding #11188]. Both entities adopt the geographic reference but they are legally distinct, separated by jurisdiction, by registry matricule, and by roughly five years of incorporation history.

Because the Saleve name recurs across these distinct vehicles, references to the 2015 hearing belong to the French SARL rather than to the Luxembourg B223232 record, which cannot support a 2015 connection [Finding #11188].

sections.title: Significance to the Investigation
sections.content:
Compagnie Du Saleve SA is significant for three reasons. First, the shared 12 rue Guillaume Schneider domicile co-locates a Rothschild & Co Five Arrows subsidiary with SPQR Capital Holding SA — the Benedetti / des Pallières Wind Hellas creditor vehicle liquidated on 16 March 2023 — and with eleven entities recorded in the ICIJ Offshore Leaks Panama Papers data, indicating that the NeoTrust Fiduciary domicile services a structurally heterogeneous client base spanning institutional private equity and litigation-distressed creditor vehicles [Finding #11211][Finding #11215].

Second, analysis of the mandate roster indicates Saleve is the first documented bridge between Mathieu Villaume’s contract-directorship portfolio and the Rothschild & Co Five Arrows orbit — the specific cross-jurisdiction custodian pattern that connects Benedetti, des Pallières and Raffaele Mincione through Asherco LLP and the SPQR vehicle stack [Finding #11166][Finding #11129].

Third, the Five Arrows AutoBench Holding Sarl liquidation on 21 November 2024 leaves Saleve’s upstream ownership chain temporarily ambiguous in the public registry — the entity remains active and its directors are unchanged, but the 100-percent shareholder of record is itself in dissolution — a structural state that warrants a registry refresh to identify any successor vehicle or direct-fund transfer [Finding #11211][Finding #11213].

open_questions: Following the 21 November 2024 liquidation of Five Arrows AutoBench Holding Sarl, who is the current shareholder of record of Compagnie Du Saleve SA's EUR 6,854,000 share capital, and to which Rothschild & Co Five Arrows fund or successor vehicle did the B223232 shares transfer?

What underlying assets does Compagnie Du Saleve SA hold? The EUR 6,854,000 capitalisation suggests a specific portfolio company or asset rather than a generic conduit, but no holdings, financial statements, or affiliate filings are documented in the registry record reviewed.

What was the rationale for the 25 January 2023 board reshuffle that terminated Othman Baraka and Lucie Delamontagne and immediately preceded the 8 March 2023 ownership transfer to Five Arrows AutoBench Holding Sarl? Six weeks separates the two events and the ordering is consistent with a transaction-preparation step.

Is the now-closed French SARL #803012046 in Monnetier-Mornex, Haute-Savoie correctly identified as the Luxembourg-2015-hearing entity, and if so, what corporate continuity (if any) connects it to Compagnie Du Saleve SA B223232 beyond the shared Salève toponym?

Beyond Mathieu Villaume's directorship, is there any documented operational, banking, or counsel overlap between Compagnie Du Saleve SA and SPQR Capital Holding SA, or is the connection limited to the shared NeoTrust Fiduciary domicile?
